title: 'Deeply shocked': Gisèle Pelicot to sue publisher after nude photos used in book campaign
summary: French feminist icon Gisèle Pelicot, who became a worldwide symbol against sexual violence during the 2024 rape trials against her husband and dozens of other men, said Monday she will take legal action after nude images of her were sent out without her permission to publicise a psychoanalyst's book on coercive control.
